conditions: Titrate the degrader across a wide range to see the hook effect; use purified E3 complex and target
reagents: Purified target; purified E3 complex; labeled or tagged reagents
rationale: Explains degradation potency and cooperativity; ternary stability does not guarantee degradation
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Whether loss of the target depends on the intended ubiquitin-proteasome pathway
readouts: Same readout as U3 with rescue conditions
conditions: Pre-treat with a proteasome inhibitor, a neddylation inhibitor or excess E3 ligand; compare E3-knockout cells where available
reagents: Cell line; proteasome and neddylation inhibitors; competing E3 ligand; same detection reagents as U3
rationale: Separates true degradation from transcription or toxicity effects
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Ligand-dependent binding of a coactivator peptide to the ligand-binding domain
readouts: TR-FRET / HTRF; AlphaScreen / AlphaLISA; fluorescence polarization
conditions: Tagged ligand-binding domain and labeled coactivator motif peptide; agonist near EC80 for antagonist mode
reagents: Purified ligand-binding domain construct; labeled coactivator peptide; reference agonist and antagonist
rationale: Standard biochemical readout of receptor activation state; the construct must include the ligand-binding domain
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Ligand-dependent transcriptional activation
readouts: Luciferase reporter
conditions: Cells expressing the receptor with a response-element reporter; 16-24 h compound treatment; agonist and antagonist modes
reagents: Reporter cell line; reference agonist and antagonist; luciferase detection reagent
rationale: Functional readout including cell permeability; luciferase inhibitors and cytotoxicity need counterscreens
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Displacement of a labeled ligand from the ligand-binding domain
readouts: Fluorescence polarization; TR-FRET; radioligand binding
conditions: Labeled ligand near its Kd; equilibrium incubation
reagents: Purified ligand-binding domain; labeled ligand; reference ligand
rationale: Shows direct ligand-pocket binding; agonist and antagonist cannot be told apart
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Conversion of supercoiled or catenated DNA by the topoisomerase
readouts: Fluorescence-based supercoiled-DNA assays; gel-based (PAGE / EMSA) (agarose)
conditions: Supercoiled plasmid (type I and II) or kinetoplast DNA (type II decatenation); ATP for type II; defined unit of enzyme
reagents: Purified topoisomerase; supercoiled or catenated DNA; ATP (type II); reference inhibitor
rationale: Direct catalytic readout; gel formats are low throughput and fluorescence formats need validation
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Trapping of the covalent DNA-enzyme cleavage complex
readouts: Gel-based (PAGE / EMSA) with plasmid linearization or labeled DNA; radiometric
conditions: Incubate compound with enzyme and DNA, then trap the complex with SDS and protease; compare poison and catalytic-inhibitor behavior
reagents: Purified topoisomerase; plasmid or labeled DNA; SDS and protease; reference poison
rationale: Separates topoisomerase poisons from catalytic inhibitors, which behave very differently in cells
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Topoisomerase-DNA covalent complexes or the resulting DNA damage in cells
readouts: Immunodetection of trapped complexes; gamma-H2AX imaging
conditions: Short compound exposure then complex isolation or fixation; include a reference poison
reagents: Relevant cell line; antibodies; reference poison
rationale: Confirms poison activity in cells; DNA-damage readouts are not specific to topoisomerases
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Disruption of the interaction between an RNA-binding protein and its RNA
readouts: Fluorescence polarization with labeled RNA; AlphaScreen / AlphaLISA; TR-FRET / HTRF
conditions: Labeled RNA near its Kd; RNase-free reagents and added RNase inhibitor; equilibrium incubation
reagents: Purified RNA-binding protein; labeled RNA; RNase inhibitor; reference binder
rationale: Standard HTS format for RNA-protein interactions; compounds that bind RNA directly are a main artifact class; UniProt does not annotate the RNA itself, so RNA-structure targets use --modality rna_target
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Direct binding of compounds to the RNA or the RNA-protein complex
readouts: SPR / BLI; ITC; fluorescent indicator displacement
conditions: Biotinylated or labeled RNA immobilized or in solution; matched buffers; non-specific nucleic-acid control
reagents: Purified RNA or RNA-binding protein; biosensor chips or tips; reference binder
rationale: Separates binding to the RNA from binding to the protein; requires well-folded RNA
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Autophagosome-to-autolysosome flux in cells
readouts: High-content imaging of a tandem fluorescent LC3 reporter
conditions: GFP is quenched in acidic autolysosomes while mCherry persists, so the red-to-yellow shift reports flux; include a lysosomal inhibitor (for example bafilomycin A1) and an inducer as controls
reagents: Stable reporter cell line; inducer and lysosomal inhibitor controls; high-content imager
rationale: Distinguishes increased autophagy initiation from blocked flux, which total-LC3 counts cannot
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

assay_name: Reporter-gene assay (CRE, NFAT or SRE luciferase)
measures: Transcription driven by the receptor's signaling pathway
readouts: Luciferase reporter
conditions: Reporter cells expressing the receptor; stimulation of several hours; agonist near EC80 for antagonist mode; add-and-read luciferase detection
reagents: Receptor-expressing reporter cell line; reference agonist and antagonist; luciferase detection reagent
rationale: Amplified, stable signal that is easy to run; the slow readout lets compound effects on transcription and luciferase inhibitors interfere, so pair it with GPCR7 and G6
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

assay_name: Physiological response assay (for example glucose-stimulated insulin secretion for incretin receptors)
measures: A tissue-relevant functional output of the receptor
readouts: ELISA / immunosorbent; HTRF / AlphaLISA immunoassay of the secreted product
conditions: Relevant cell line or primary cells; compare low and high glucose (for insulin secretion); co-incubate compound with the agonist; normalize to cellular content
reagents: Relevant cell line or islets; secreted-product immunoassay; reference agonist
rationale: Shows the compound produces the intended physiological effect; low throughput and the assay depends on the receptor's tissue biology
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Compounds from mixtures that bind the purified protein
readouts: Mass spectrometry
conditions: Incubate protein with compound pools, separate bound from free (size exclusion or filtration), then identify binders by LC-MS; needs stable, purified protein (membrane proteins need solubilization)
reagents: Purified protein; compound pools; LC-MS system
rationale: Finds binders without a functional assay, useful when no activity assay exists or for hard targets; hits show binding only, not function
status: draft by Claude 2026-11-05; needs expert review

measures: Potency across the HDAC and sirtuin isoforms

reagents: Purified HDAC isoforms; isoform-appropriate substrates; detection reagents
rationale: Isoform selectivity drives both efficacy and toxicity for HDAC inhibitors

measures: HDAC activity inside live cells
